content.text: Health Canada's guidance is around 6 months, so Theo is close at 5 months. Until then, milk is still all he needs. Start when he's sitting with support, holding his head steady, and reaching for your food. A first food that's rich in iron, like iron-fortified cereal or well-cooked mashed meat or beans, is a good place to start. Confirm the timing with your provider or public health.
